scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names API,MOBILE --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "cd artifacts/api-server && pnpm run dev" "cd artifacts/mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 pnpm run dev:local"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:ci: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/mobile" --filter "./artifacts/api-server" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
